question:
Select the meaningful and correctly spelt word from the given options to fill in the blank.

The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth’s surface, making them the largest ____________ on the planet.
solution:
The correct answer is '**habitat**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**habitat**" means the natural home or environment of an organism. (आवासीय स्थान)
 
• The oceans serve as a habitat for countless marine species, making them the largest habitat on the planet.
 
• The other options: "**hybrid**," "**habiltude**," and "**habit**" do not fit the context or are incorrectly spelt.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth’s surface, making them the largest habitat__ on the planet.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hybrid (संकर)**: means a mix or combination of two different elements.
 
• **Habiltude**: is an incorrect spelling and does not exist as a valid word.
 
• **Habit (आदत)**: refers to a regular practice or tendency.
